ops.title: Go/Rust bindings architecture: Rust core + WASM-in-Go, Python as conformance oracle, lockstep releases
ops.body:
Decided 2026-07-18 (user-approved plan). Go and Rust bindings live in this monorepo (`go/`, `rust/`) and cover the full portable surface (run/call/extract + select_backend/status; claude/codex/gemini/agy CLI backends + OpenAI-endpoint HTTP; MLX excluded).

**DRY mechanism (user-confirmed):** all drift-prone pure logic — per-backend argv/env/stdin/result-file planning, envelope parsing, both strict-schema transforms, JSON extraction, transient detection + backoff, routing tables, Claude isolation seeding + keychain-service sha256 — lives once in the sans-io `rust/spawnllm-core` crate, behind a `dispatch(op_json) -> result_json` boundary (ops: version, capabilities, plan, resolve, strict_schema, extract_json, retry_decision, auth_probes, claude_isolation_sources/seed). The Rust `spawnllm` crate links it natively; the Go module embeds it as a committed wasm32-wasip1 blob run under wazero (pure Go, no cgo). Hosts own all I/O (spawn/reap, temp files, keychain subprocess, HTTP, retry sleeps, validation).

**Python stays untouched** as the shipped reference implementation (consumers mock its internals; MLX keeps it Python) and is the conformance ORACLE: `tests/conformance/generate.py` snapshots real behavior into committed `conformance/vectors/`; Python (freshness test), Rust core (native), and Go (through the wazero glue) all replay them in CI. A behavior change = regen vectors + port to core in the same PR.

**Releases are LOCKSTEP** on the existing `v*` tag: release-pypi.yml untouched; new release-crates.yml stamps the Cargo workspace version from the tag (`cargo set-version --workspace`) and publishes via crates.io OIDC trusted publishing (env `crates-io`; first publish needs a one-time classic token — both crate names verified free 2026-07-18); new release-go.yml mints the `go/vX.Y.Z` alias tag Go requires for a subdirectory module. Verified: GitHub's `v*` tag filter cannot match `go/v*` (no `/` in glob `*`), and GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger workflows. Committed versions stay `0.0.0` sentinels; the tag is the sole version source. Partial releases fix forward, never retag. Never rename release-pypi.yml (PyPI trusted publisher binds the filename).

Full plan: /Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-01/plans/we-shiuld-have-golang-hidden-salamander.md
